messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: p99 latency > 3s for customer Cascade Enterprise (vpc-cascade-eu1). Current window 5m, impacted routes: /generate-chat, /embed. Triggered at 2026-03-15T02:05:12Z. Paging oncall.

olivia_ryan: acked, joining. seeing p95 ~ 850ms, p99 ~ 3.4s on eu1-dedicated pool. dashboard: https://console.redwood/internal/metrics?pool=eu1-dedicated&tenant=cascade

samir_khan: I'm in. tagging @diego_mora for tenant-level traffic. Diego, can you confirm if any recent rollout for cascade-tenant-42?

diego_mora: not aware of rollout on their side. No commits in last 24h for cascade. I can pull tenant traffic heatmap.

maya_ops: adding context: autoscaler didn't spin new workers for eu1-dedicated due to quota limit errors 403 from infra API. logs: `scale_request denied: quota-gpu-cores`.

olivia_ryan: copy. so two vectors: tenant surge + failed autoscale. first priority: contain customer impact and restore p99 below SLO.

beth_cs: Cascade success team here. Customer on call: Mark (cascade-oncall@cascade.com). He's been paged and is monitoring. Please keep me posted before any tenant isolation.

samir_khan: mitigation plan: 1) throttle bursty traffic from tenant (rate-limit 2x baseline) 2) attempt manual scale-up if quota can be adjusted 3) if still failing p99, run tenant isolation to dedicated spare capacity 4) notify customer and handoff to Incident Lead for postmortem.

diego_mora: running quick query to find offending patterns. ```sql
SELECT route, count(*) as rps, avg(tokens) as avg_tokens
FROM requests
WHERE tenant_id='cascade-tenant-42' AND ts > now() - interval '10 minutes'
GROUP BY route
ORDER BY rps DESC
LIMIT 10;
```

diego_mora: results: /generate-chat rps 42 (avg_tokens 1200), /embed rps 18 (avg_tokens 512). spike started ~02:00Z.

maya_ops: infra side: quota escalation request submitted to cloud team (ticket #CLD-7821). Expected response ETA 20m. Meanwhile I can attempt manual scale to warm-spare pool if we permit cross-pool burst. Anyone object?

olivia_ryan: do it. we need immediate relief. If cross-pool burst reduces p99 below 2s, avoid tenant isolation.

samir_khan: Diego, please apply a temporary soft-rate-limit on cascade-tenant-42 at ingress: `rate_limit: requests_per_minute: 3000` and `burst: 500`. That should shape the spike.

diego_mora: applied ingress rule via feature-flagger: `ff update cascade:ingress-throttle --rpm 3000 --burst 500`. Propagated to edge in ~8s.

beth_cs: Mark confirmed they can tolerate short rate-limits; cascade product asked for graceful degradation rather than hard rejects.

incident-bot: NOTE: Incident annotated: runbook ecs:dedicated-pool-surge. Assigned severity: sev2.

maya_ops: cross-pool burst in progress: moving 2x workers from eu2-warm-spare into eu1-burst. Patch command: `infra move-workers --from eu2-warm-spare --to eu1-dedicated --count 2`

olivia_ryan: done. I'm seeing immediate drop p95 -> 620ms, p99 -> 1.9s. Good signal. Keep monitoring 5m window.

samir_khan: keep the throttle for now. Also let's enable KV prefix caching for cascade chat prefix to reduce repeated compute for long conversations. Diego, can you flip cache ttl to 60s for that tenant?

diego_mora: toggled prefix cache TTL to 60s in routing config: `route-config cascade-chat:prefix_cache_ttl=60s`

olivia_ryan: excellent. metrics trending down. p99 now 1.6s. Maya, any update from cloud quota ticket?

maya_ops: CLD-7821: approved temporary quota bump +10 GPU cores for eu1 for 2 hours. I've queued automated scale now.

samir_khan: schedule: keep throttle & cache, allow scale to complete, then slowly relax throttle if p99 stable <1s for 10m. Document actions for postmortem.

beth_cs: passing note to customer: Mark says they'll run a quick job to reduce their embed batch size. will update if they change traffic pattern.

olivia_ryan: we're going to remove isolation plan for now. no eviction. if p99 creeps back after quota expires, we may need to pre-authorize isolation.

incident-bot: Handoff scheduled: oncall_rotation will take after 02:30Z. Add runbook link: https://runbooks.redwood/incidents/dedicated-pool-surge

oncall_rotation: taking over monitoring. I've bookmarked checks and set alert for p99 > 1.2s. Who is incident lead?

samir_khan: I'm incident lead for this warroom. Samir -> Diego handoff in 15m for throttles/cache. Olivia to coordinate with CS for customer comms.

olivia_ryan: prepping short customer update: "We saw a transient spike affecting p99 for your EU1 pool due to increased request volume and autoscale delay. We applied rate limiting, cache tuning, and temporary capacity; metrics are back within SLO. We'll follow up with full RCA and recommended config changes." Beth, send when ready.

beth_cs: sending now. Mark confirmed receipt and appreciates the quick mitigation.

samir_khan: post-incident actions (to capture now): - investigate root cause of autoscaler quota denial - add pre-authorized warm-spare burst for Cascade (optionally increase reserved capacity) - build guardrail to detect tenant token-length spikes that cause large compute - add escalation playbook for soft-throttle vs isolate - schedule joint runbook review with Cascade.

diego_mora: capturing logs for the spike and snapshotting KV cache hit rates. I'll export to /incidents/4132101112/artifacts.tar.gz

maya_ops: cloud quota temp bump will expire at 04:05Z. I'll set an automated alert 10m before expiry to re-evaluate.

oncall_rotation: p99 stable at 0.92s over 10m window. closing warroom monitoring in 10m unless regress. moving to watch-state.

olivia_ryan: thanks team. Samir, please own the follow-ups and write the incident summary. Assigning to you for the postmortem doc.

samir_khan: will do. adding tasks to tracker and assigning.

beth_cs: Customer happy for a follow-up write-up and a sync next week. I'll coordinate calendars.

incident-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED (provisional): p99 below SLO for 20m. Please ensure postmortem and action items are tracked.

olivia_ryan: closing thread. If anyone sees regression reopen. Good job everyone :thumbsup:
